related.title: Linux epoll：邊緣觸發與排空規則
related.titleEn: Linux epoll: edge-triggering and drain rules
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付window-budget.csv與資料雜湊；不以截斷映射檔案方式測試真實SIGBUS。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver window-budget.csv and data digests without truncating a live mapped file to trigger SIGBUS. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 以ready布林、佇列長度與event計數建狀態機；區分短讀、EOF及EAGAIN。
related.differenceEn: Model ready state, queue length and event count, distinguishing short reads, EOF and EAGAIN.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
檔案映射offset需符合系統頁對齊要求；所需子區段可用對齊起點加delta表示。映射成功不代表所有頁已載入。
本課數值核對：5000-floor(5000/4096)*4096 = 904 B；另一項核對：904+3000 = 3904 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

邊緣觸發通知狀態變化；非阻塞讀者通常需讀到EAGAIN才能等待下一次事件。一次事件不等於一筆訊息。
本課數值核對：ceil(10/4) = 3 reads；另一項核對：10-4 = 6 remaining_B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
File mapping offsets must satisfy system page alignment; a subrange is represented by an aligned start plus delta. Successful mapping does not mean all pages are loaded.
Numeric audit: 5000-floor(5000/4096)*4096 = 904 B; second audit: 904+3000 = 3904 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Edge-triggered notification reports state changes; a nonblocking reader generally drains to EAGAIN before waiting again. One event is not one message.
Numeric audit: ceil(10/4) = 3 reads; second audit: 10-4 = 6 remaining_B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: SQLite WAL：讀取快照與 checkpoint
related.titleEn: SQLite WAL: reader snapshots and checkpoints
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付window-budget.csv與資料雜湊；不以截斷映射檔案方式測試真實SIGBUS。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver window-budget.csv and data digests without truncating a live mapped file to trigger SIGBUS. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 列reader start/end與writer commit序號，畫read mark與checkpoint watermark；實際WAL header不納入payload模型；checkpoint不會截掉檔案前綴，重設／截斷另受讀者限制。
related.differenceEn: Trace reader starts/ends and writer commit sequences, drawing read marks and checkpoint watermarks; exclude WAL headers from the payload model. Checkpointing does not truncate a prefix, and reset/truncation has reader constraints.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
檔案映射offset需符合系統頁對齊要求；所需子區段可用對齊起點加delta表示。映射成功不代表所有頁已載入。
本課數值核對：5000-floor(5000/4096)*4096 = 904 B；另一項核對：904+3000 = 3904 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

WAL讀者保留開始讀取時的可見邊界；checkpoint不能任意越過仍需舊狀態的讀者。長讀取會影響回收。
本課數值核對：100*4096 = 409600 total_page_payload_B；另一項核對：(100-40)*4096 = 245760 uncheckpointed_page_payload_B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
File mapping offsets must satisfy system page alignment; a subrange is represented by an aligned start plus delta. Successful mapping does not mean all pages are loaded.
Numeric audit: 5000-floor(5000/4096)*4096 = 904 B; second audit: 904+3000 = 3904 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

WAL readers retain a visibility boundary from read start; checkpointing cannot disregard readers needing older state. Long readers affect reclamation.
Numeric audit: 100*4096 = 409600 total_page_payload_B; second audit: (100-40)*4096 = 245760 uncheckpointed_page_payload_B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
